questions.solution:
$\$ P($\mathrm{n}$): 2^\{$\mathrm{n}$\}$ Since
$P(1): 2 < 1$ is false.
$P(2): 2^{2} < 2 !$ is false
$P(3): 2^{3} < 3 !$ is false
$P(4): 2^{4} < 4 !$ is true.
$P(5): 2^{5} < 5 !$ is true.
